long_biography.plain_text:
Mytilineos took over the family metal-representation business in 1978, then established MYTILINEOS Holdings twelve years later. A public listing followed in the middle of the next decade. Majority acquisitions of METKA and Aluminium of Greece transformed the enterprise from a trading house into an integrated industrial group with construction, alumina, aluminium and bauxite operations.

He subsequently moved into electricity and natural gas, developing Protergia as the group's energy brand and combining those activities with metals under one corporate structure. Renamed METLEN three decades after founding, the company completed a London listing in 2025. Mytilineos became executive chairman the following year, retaining strategic leadership as the group expanded across power generation, renewable projects and green metallurgy.
